description: Chief Secretariate Office - Southern Province - Co-operative Societies Act, No. 05 of 1972, as amended by Acts No. 32 of 1983 and No. 11 of 1992 orders on delegation of Powers (Amendment)
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Mrs. Piyadigoda Liyanage Bhagya Chathurani Liyanage) and detailed descriptions of the specific powers and responsibilities being delegated to her (sections 03, 05, 06, etc., of the Co-operative Societies Act and specific rules from the Code of rules). It also names the Governor (William Wijesinghe Gamage) who is making the assignment. This combination of specific personnel and detailed portfolio responsibilities meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
